title: 輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合
titleEn: Street integration of grooved-rail light rail
summary: 本課聚焦槽型鋼軌輪緣界面排水與街道交通協調。從輪緣槽幾何誤差預算建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把鋼軌與鋪面自由變形與路面混行的停止距離連成可驗證的介面，最後以街道介面交付案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies grooved-rail flange interfaces, drainage and street-traffic coordination. Start with flangeway geometry uncertainty budget to define physical or information boundaries, connect free movement of rail and pavement with stopping distance in shared streets as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through street-interface acceptance cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪緣槽幾何誤差預算。原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。公式 y=groove+flange+survey，代入得 y=0.9 mm。邊界：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。敏感度只改 groove=0.4 至 0.44 mm，輸出變為 0.94 mm；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究街道集水與排水需求：原創假想教學輸入：假想逕流係數 C=0.7 1；教學降雨強度 i=30 mm/h；集水面積 A=120 m2。公式 y=C*i*A/3600，代入得 y=0.7 L/s。邊界：均勻穩定降雨的簡化需求模型，未求排水容量、集流延遲或淹水水深。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。將槽型製造、輪緣幾何與測量界限分開相加，所得只是誤差預算而非實際槽寬。用斷面圖標明接觸和非接觸位置，避免把範例數值誤作驗收限值。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate flangeway geometry uncertainty budget. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm. Formula y=groove+flange+survey gives y=0.9 mm. Boundary: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit. For sensitivity, change only groove=0.4 to 0.44 mm; the output becomes 0.94 mm. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate street runoff and drainage demand: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: assumed runoff coefficient C=0.7 1; teaching rainfall intensity i=30 mm/h; catchment area A=120 m2. Formula y=C*i*A/3600 gives y=0.7 L/s. Boundary: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Sum manufacturing, flange-geometry and survey bounds as an uncertainty budget rather than an actual groove width. Mark contact and clearance locations on a section sketch without converting example values into acceptance limits. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算與街道集水與排水需求
stages.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget & Street runoff and drainage demand
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」與「街道集水與排水需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget" and "Street runoff and drainage demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」如何影響輕軌槽型鋼軌街道整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Street integration of grooved-rail light rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 將槽型製造、輪緣幾何與測量界限分開相加，所得只是誤差預算而非實際槽寬。用斷面圖標明接觸和非接觸位置，避免把範例數值誤作驗收限值。槽形鋼軌與輪緣之間的幾何介面包含製造、磨耗與量測的不確定度。把各個最大誤差同向相加可得到保守的誤差預算，但不能因此推得槽寬、輪緣空間或真正間隙；實際幾何還需要名義尺寸、變形與曲線姿態，而行人和自行車風險屬另一組介面需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sum manufacturing, flange-geometry and survey bounds as an uncertainty budget rather than an actual groove width. Mark contact and clearance locations on a section sketch without converting example values into acceptance limits. The groove–flange interface contains uncertainty from manufacturing, wear and measurement. Adding same-direction maximum error bounds gives a conservative uncertainty budget, not the groove width, flange clearance or actual gap. Real geometry also needs nominal dimensions, deformation and curve attitude. Pedestrian and bicycle risks form a separate set of street-interface requirements. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三項誤差界的總和就是現場鋼軌槽內的實際間隙」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sum of three error bounds is the actual clearance inside the rail groove." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：槽形製造誤差界 groove=0.4 mm；輪緣幾何誤差界 flange=0.3 mm；測量誤差界 survey=0.2 mm。公式 y=groove+flange+survey，代入得 y=0.9 mm。邊界：僅合成三個有界誤差，不是實際槽寬、輪緣間隙或允收限值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: groove manufacturing error bound groove=0.4 mm; flange geometry error bound flange=0.3 mm; survey error bound survey=0.2 mm. Formula y=groove+flange+survey gives y=0.9 mm. Boundary: Three bounded errors only, not actual groove width, flange clearance or an acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立量具核對槽形與輪緣輪廓，在相同座標保留名義尺寸及誤差符號，另檢查測量零點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check groove and flange profiles with independent gauges, retain nominal dimensions and error signs in one coordinate system, and verify instrument zeros separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 輪緣槽幾何誤差預算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flangeway geometry uncertainty budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立量具核對槽形與輪緣輪廓，在相同座標保留名義尺寸及誤差符號，另檢查測量零點。以「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check groove and flange profiles with independent gauges, retain nominal dimensions and error signs in one coordinate system, and verify instrument zeros separately. For flangeway geometry uncertainty budget, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把槽形製造誤差界 groove 從 0.4 改成 0.44 mm（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.9 變為 0.94 mm。先說明「輪緣槽幾何誤差預算」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only groove manufacturing error bound groove from 0.4 to 0.44 mm (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.9 to 0.94 mm. Explain the causal direction for flangeway geometry uncertainty budget, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將誤差總和當成實際間隙會省略名義幾何；共用失準量具還可能讓兩個錯誤輪廓看似互相吻合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating an error sum as the actual gap omits nominal geometry; a shared miscalibrated gauge can also make two incorrect profiles appear mutually compatible. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 先劃定會流向軌槽的集水面積，將雨強、面積與逕流係數放到一致單位。計算結果只是來水需求，仍需另查坡度、堵塞和排水出口能力。降雨逕流需求可由雨強、集水面積與逕流係數估算，毫米乘平方米等於公升。這個需求量尚未描述排水口能力，槽內泥砂、路面坡度和尾水都會影響真正排放；短小雨場的計算也不能代表暴雨頻率與都市集水區的完整水文過程。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：均勻穩定降雨的簡化需求模型，未求排水容量、集流延遲或淹水水深。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「街道集水與排水需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Delineate the area draining toward the rail and use consistent rainfall, area and runoff units. The result is inflow demand; slopes, blockage and outlet capacity need separate assessment. Rainfall runoff demand follows intensity, catchment area and a runoff coefficient, with millimetres times square metres giving litres. This demand does not describe inlet capacity. Sediment, pavement slope and tailwater affect actual discharge, while a short simple event cannot represent storm frequency or the full hydrology of an urban catchment. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Simple demand under uniform steady rainfall; drain capacity, concentration delay and flood depth are not solved. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Street runoff and drainage demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「街道介面交付案例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Street-interface acceptance cases” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 縮小分母可讓覆蓋率看似提高，重複案例也可能掩蓋邊界狀態根本未被執行。回到「街道介面交付案例」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shrinking the denominator makes coverage look better; duplicate cases can hide boundary states that were never exercised. Trace the input chain for street-interface acceptance cases. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：計數式已知案例覆蓋，不是失效機率或安全完整性量化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Count-based coverage of known cases, not a probability of failure or a safety-integrity measure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
